The 10th Walpurgis Night
The 10th Walpurgis Night
[The 10th Walpurgis Night] unlocks regardless of your progress in the Main Story. Enter via the event banner on the Window or the Driverside tabs.
Event Period
The duration of The 10th Walpurgis Night event is shown here. During the event, complete Missions for Easy and Hard difficulty event Encounters and claim their rewards.
Easy Difficulty Encounter

Select the door to begin the Easy difficulty Encounter. The Encounter consumes Enkephalin Module upon entry. On Easy difficulty, any Deployed Identities under Level 65 will be raised to Level 65. Also, any Deployed Identities and E.G.O under Tier 3 Uptie/Threadspinning Level will be raised to Tier 3 Uptie/Threadspinning Level.
Hard Difficulty Encounter
Clearing the Easy difficulty Encounter unlocks the Hard difficulty. In Hard difficulty, your Identities' current Levels, Uptie Tiers, and E.G.O Threadspinning Tiers will be reflected.
Patron Librarian [Floor of History]

The #1 Sinner to be deployed in the Teams menu will be imbued with the "Patron Librarian [Floor of History]" effect. The Sinner with the "Patron Librarian [Floor of History]" effect will gain more Slots and other beneficial effects.
Missions
You can enter the [Missions] page, where you can view the list of Missions to be completed during the Encounter and their rewards.
You can view the Reward Exchange period in the [Missions] page.
Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty each has different sets of Missions to complete.
Complete these Missions and claim various rewards from the [Missions] page.
Even after the event fully ends, you will be able to experience the "The 10th Walpurgis Night" combat Encounters and view its story anytime at the Driverside and Theater - [Detour Tales].
